title: Pin the governed generated-artifact refresh chain to an explicit hosted runner

phases.objective: Remove the mutable ubuntu-latest dependency from every load-bearing stage of the governed generated-artifact refresh request, decision, writer, and verification chain.

e2e_journeys.actor: trusted request, dispatch, writer, and verification workflows
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: An eligible exact-head generated-artifact refresh request enters the read-only pull_request_target evaluator.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Every load-bearing stage requests ubuntu-24.04 explicitly, preserves the existing authorization and exact-head contracts, and delegates repository mutation only to the governed writer.
steps: Evaluate the same-repository exact-head request on ubuntu-24.04.
Consume the run-bound request artifact in the trusted dispatcher on ubuntu-24.04.
Execute the V2 decision dispatcher on ubuntu-24.04.
Run the registered generated-artifact writer on ubuntu-24.04.
Run the read-only post-write verification on ubuntu-24.04.
assertions: No load-bearing workflow in the governed refresh chain uses ubuntu-latest.
The request stage remains read-only and performs no candidate checkout or API mutation.
Dispatchers remain exact-head bound and reject protected branches before mutation.
Only the governed writer retains contents:write authority.
No Production, provider, credential, database, migration, protected-ref, force-push, or external-send authority is introduced.

phases.objective: Observe one exact-head request traverse request, dispatcher, writer, and verification with concrete run IDs.
Confirm stale heads, drafts, forks, missing labels, invalid branches, and protected refs continue to fail closed.
This repository automation patch performs no provider or deployment canary.
The patch grants no Production, migration, database, provider, credential, or deployment authority.
